en: Black‑and‑white view of a tall neo‑Gothic brick church with a very slender spire capped by an ornate metal finial. The façade shows pointed arches, statues in niches, buttresses, and a clock on the tower. The church stands behind a low wall along a wide, mostly empty street lined with mature trees. A few pedestrians are visible in early‑20th‑century clothing, and several brick residential buildings appear in the background.
